newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Yevroseverneft wins 38 pct KomiTEK stake.
newsitem.headline: Russian Yevroseverneft wins 38 pct KomiTEK stake.

text.p: Russian company Yevroseverneft won a tender for a 38 percent stake in the KomiTEK oil company, the State Property Fund said on Wednesday.
Yevroseverneft, an unknown company registered in Moscow, offered $19.03 million for the stake. KomiTEK's main production unit is Komineft.
A spokesman for the Natsionalny Reservny Bank told Reuters the bank undertook payment guarantees for the winner of the investment tender. A minimum accepted offer at the tender was $14 million.
A total of 63.14 million 10-rouble shares were on offer at an initial price of 350 roubles per share. KomiTEK's statutory fund is 1.66 billion roubles.
Foreign investors were barred from participating in the tender.
The money received at the tender is due to be used to finance construction of a 138 km oil pipeline in northern Russia and to repay KomiTEK's arrears to the state budget, the spokesman said.
